opportunities.point: Management stated that on a long-term basis, a 25% PAT margin should be considered reasonable.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "See, on a long-term basis, whenever I am asked kind of a guidance, I always say that 25% is something that you should consider on a long-term basis." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management provided a top-line guidance above INR400 crores and INR100 crores PAT for FY28.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "The guidance that I give is above INR400 crores and INR100 crores PAT." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The total capex for the plant is around INR75 crores and around INR14 odd crores for machinery, totaling around INR90 crores.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "So, the total as given in the offer document is around INR75 crores for the plant and I think around INR14 odd crores for the machinery, totalling to around INR90 crores." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The Ambernath plant size was increased to 2,50,000 square feet by re-engineering the plant style and utilizing a basement and FSI allowance.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Originally, we were going to make 1,75,000 square feet, but we have been able to make 2,50,000 square feet by re-engineering our plant style, also doing a basement and things like that and optimizing our FSI allowance." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The shares trade under the model's intrinsic value.

opportunities.point: A consumer durables tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Management noted that retail rollouts as a whole are on an increase, and the company is taking its share of the pie from that increase.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "So, the number of stores rollout as retail as a whole, I think is on an increase. So, we are taking a share -- our share of the pie from that increase." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management stated that the company is well positioned to sustain growth, supported by increasing outsourcing by organized retailers and continued demand for innovative retail fixture and fit-out solutions...
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Well positioned to sustain growth, supported by increasing outsourcing by organized retailers and continued demand for innovative retail fixture and fit-out solutions across key consumption categories." (concall ppt - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "These refurbishment orders are kind of repeat in nature, following roughly a three to four-year repeat cycle." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Current capacity utilization from existing plants is upwards of 90%.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "From the existing plants, we are upwards of 90%." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The new Ambernath plant with 250,000 sq.ft. capacity remains on track for completion by December 2026.

(concall ppt - 2025-11-01) [FY27]

threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "It happened in March when there was a gas shortage, etcetera. We had faced problems in our powder coating plant because obviously powder coating works on, you know, gas. So, that was, but that got solved in a few weeks and everything was back to normal." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)
